title: Add RecipeTagChips view
description: Create RecipeTagChips.swift. Reads the 'tags' metadata key from Recipe.metadata, splits on commas (trimming whitespace), and renders a horizontally-scrolling row of pill-shaped chips. Each chip is text-only with .foregroundStyle(.tint) and a .regularMaterial background. The entire row is hidden (not rendered as empty space) when the tags key is absent or its value is empty after splitting.
acceptance_criteria: A chip is rendered for each comma-separated tag value.
The row is entirely hidden when tags metadata is absent or empty.
Chips scroll horizontally when they overflow available width.
